knowHow.text: Even under continuous loading at high temperatures rigidity, strength and creep resistance remain unchanged.
The filament also has remarkable chemical resistance – it is virtually insoluble in any known solvent, including concentrated acids and bases.
A distinctive feature of Spectrum PPS AM230 is its inherent non-flammability, even without using flame-retardant additives.
Ruby or hardened nozzle not necessary

polymer.asPrinted: crystallises, not driven by its melting point
polymer.basis: Handbook values; printed hot PPS crystallises (IPCON PPS GF 241 °C, Bambu PPS-CF 264 °C unannealed), but its heat deflection is not modelled on its melting point (D56). Mitsubishi Chemical Advanced Materials' sheet for Techtron 1000 PPS (R-MCAM-TECHTRON-1000-PPS-DS), a polyphenylene sulfide that names no filler, prints a density of 1.35 g/cm³ (ISO 1183-1) and a specific gravity of 1.35 (ASTM D792), inside the density range, a melting temperature of 280 °C (ISO 11357-1/-3) beside the row's 283, and a water absorption in water at 23 °C of 0.01 % after 24 h (ISO 62 and ASTM D570) and, at saturation, 0.10 % to ISO 62 and 0.03 % to ASTM D570, p. 1.

polymerEnvironment.finding: TORELINA offers excellent resistance to chemical substances such as acids, alkalis, and organic solvents. At 200 ℃ or below, it will not dissolve in any organic solvent... On the other hand, it is somewhat less resistant to acids and alkalis at high temperatures.

polymerEnvironment.finding: If, however, it is constantly in contact with concentrated hydrochloric acid, concentrated sulfuric acid, nitric acid, amines, or halogenated hydrocarbons at high temperatures, its properties will be adversely affected.

polymerEnvironment.notes: The page gives no rating scale; verdict reading of the retention figures used here: ≥ 90 % = resistant, 75-89 % = limited. Values are for TORELINA compounds (glass-reinforced A504X90 unless stated), not neat resin.
